title: AI Reveals Hidden Side Effects of Ozempic in Reddit Posts
seoTitle: AI Reveals Hidden Ozempic Side Effects on Reddit
subtitle: Research analyzed user posts and uncovered unexpected symptoms linked to weight‑loss drugs.
excerpt: AI analyzed 400,000 Reddit posts and found unexpected symptoms reported by Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, and Zepbound users.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
An AI analysis of 400,000 Reddit posts discovered that users of medications such as Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, and Zepbound reported unexpected symptoms. Among the findings were menstrual changes, chills, hot flashes, and fatigue.

While these patterns were identified in the posts, researchers caution that they cannot definitively say the drugs caused these health issues. However, the observed patterns may highlight overlooked signals that warrant further investigation.

With information from ScienceDaily.
